transcription: These are two restaurants in Kyoto, Japan that left us utterly speechless and you need to save these now. So the first one is called Curry Intempura Coices, located in a small alleyway and they serve a unique dish of spice curry and tempura in a sushi bucket. Like how cool is that and the spice curry is made with over 20 different spices. Along with the tempura and matcha salt, this combination is too diverse. You know those meals that are so good you never wanted to end? Well, it's pretty much how we felt. And now onto restaurant number two, it's called Mare. And they specialize in Wagyu rice boxes. The chef makes everything right in front of you and again, guys, this was too die-four. As soon as I opened the lid, my mouth was watering so much. And with the egg yolk mixed inside, I literally could not believe what I was eating. The meat is so tender each bite just melts in your mouth. And again, I did not want to stop eating. To top it off, we also had some matcha ice cream and Chris is still in disbelief. This meal was so good. Oh, and I just wanted to put this place in here to warn you not to come here. transcription: If you're visiting Tokyo Japan this year, these are three of my favourite experiences from my recent trip. I say this might not be for everyone, but if you're a tattoo lover, you have to make a visit to Futuro's Tettu in Harajuku. This is my second time visiting these guys at the best for fine-line and super affordable. This time I got two tattoos and it was roughly 150 AUD. This one is a bit more niche, but if you're a game or or lover bit of virtual reality, visiting Red Tokyo Tower is a must. Senior old Tom Boyami loved this. It was full of virtual reality and interactive games, including Robot Boxing, which was wild. They strapped you into these 15 KG Robot suits to play. Perfect for going with your friends and challenging each other and you can also visit Tokyo Tower after. You want to get the best views for Shibuya Crossing, you have to book a ticket to Magnet Shibuya 109 rooftop bar. This is the perfect spot for watching Sunset over the city and starting your night out in Tokyo.
